name: Brandon Hogan
statement:
I paint the moments a community needs to remember. My practice centers on large-scale murals and live event painting — work made in public, at the scale of the room it serves — alongside commissioned portraits and church murals.
 For NewBo, that history-and-evolution thread is the work itself: a market is a place where a community's past and present already meet, and a mural there should reward both a first glance from the floor and a closer look. I would build the design collaboratively with the selection committee, and compose it around the wall as it actually is — the speakers, the glass garage walls, and the stage in front of it — rather than pretending those features are not there.
 My completed murals include a 6' × 10' astronaut mural (2022), an 8' × 4' commissioned cross mural for Rocky Mount Church (2025), and an 8' × 20' full-room residential mural (2025). As a live painter at ballparks and public celebrations, I am used to working in public, on deadline, with an audience watching the wall change.
